description: This file defines configuration settings for an application, including environment variable loading functions and a dataclass representing application settings.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Immutable dataclass holding the application's configuration, loaded from environment variables.

methods.name: str _get_env(name: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a string environment variable, raises an error if not set.

methods.name: int _get_env_int(name: str, default: int)
methods.description: Retrieves an integer environment variable, returns a default if unset or empty, raises an error if the value cannot be converted to int.

methods.name: list[str] _get_env_csv(name: str, default: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of strings from a CSV environment variable, splitting and trimming entries.

methods.name: Settings get_settings()
methods.description: Public function that returns an instance of Settings, loading values from environment variables with defaults.
